en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard depicting a large colonnaded spa hotel with trees and planters in front. Printed caption at top right reads "Bad Pyrmont. Fürstl. Kurhotel." The image side is overlaid with handwritten German text. The reverse shows a green "Deutsches Reich" postage stamp with a Pyrmont postmark, a handwritten address, and a blue museum stamp reading "MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT."
